mechanism: Moving symbol-spacing into the canonical style layout makes the unchanged Android vendored JSON fail the existing cross-repository parity check.
repair_template: Refresh the Android vendored basemap from the canonical source style without changing or skipping the parity check.

semantic_review.a1_failure: With only the source checkout changed, the target's pre-existing parity script reports wandertracks.json as different and exits nonzero after checking all five basemaps.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Full source and target diffs, Gerrit change chronology and maintainer message, the pre-existing Zuul parity job and script, and an independently run 0/1/0 pilot with five basemap checks per arm.
semantic_review.source_effect: The opening source revision moves three stray layer-level symbol-spacing keys into their corresponding layout objects in the canonical wandertracks style.
semantic_review.target_repair: The maintainer target change updates only the vendored wandertracks.json copy to the new canonical structure; it does not modify or skip the parity script.
